mnemonic.meaning: Rub (擦れ) past each other going different (違う) ways. You pass by each other.
mnemonic.reading: SURE, CHEE, GOW (すれちがう): "Sure!" you nod as you pass by each other in the hall.

examples.ja: 駅で昔の友達とすれ違った。
examples.en: I passed an old friend at the station.

items.note: Also for misunderstandings: 気持ちがすれ違う.

mnemonic.meaning: 遭 has 辶 (road): something bad meets you on the road. To encounter trouble.
mnemonic.reading: OW (あう)! You encounter trouble: a car hits a puddle and soaks you.

examples.ja: 帰り道で事故に遭った。
examples.en: I was in an accident on the way home.

items.note: Only for bad things: 事故に遭う, ひどい目に遭う. Often written 会う in casual text.

mnemonic.meaning: The feeling (情) between friends (友). Friendship.
mnemonic.reading: YOU, JOE (ゆうじょう): you and Joe, best friends forever.

examples.ja: 二人の友情は今も続いている。
examples.en: Their friendship continues to this day.

items.note: 友情 = the bond itself. 友達 = the person.

mnemonic.meaning: 章 has 音 (sound) + 十 (ten): ten sounds make a section. A chapter.
mnemonic.reading: SHOW (しょう): each chapter is like a new show.

examples.ja: この本は十の章に分かれている。
examples.en: This book is divided into ten chapters.

items.note: 第一章 = chapter one. Also badges: 勲章 (medal).

mnemonic.meaning: 裂 has 衣 (clothes) at the bottom: cloth torn apart. To rip.
mnemonic.reading: SACK (さく): you rip the sack open.

examples.ja: 布を二つに裂いた。
examples.en: I tore the cloth in two.

items.note: Figurative: 時間を割く (make time) uses 割く, also さく.

mnemonic.meaning: SO, CO-DAY (そこで): "So, today we eat cake." Therefore, thereupon.

examples.ja: 道に迷った。そこで、地図を見ることにした。
examples.en: I got lost. So I decided to look at a map.

items.note: Introduces what you did in response. Also literally "there": そこで待って.

mnemonic.meaning: Collect (収) the harvest (穫). A harvest, crop.
mnemonic.reading: SHOE, CACK (しゅうかく): the farmer harvests while his shoe goes cack in the mud.

examples.ja: 秋は米の収穫の季節だ。
examples.en: Autumn is the season for harvesting rice.

items.note: Also results from effort: 今日の会議は収穫があった (today's meeting was fruitful).

mnemonic.meaning: Sudden (急) and fast (速). Rapid.
mnemonic.reading: CUE, SOCK (きゅうそく): on cue, the sock flies off rapidly.

examples.ja: 町は急速に発展した。
examples.en: The town developed rapidly.

items.note: Formal. Usually 急速に.

mnemonic.meaning: The amount (額) of money (金). A sum.
mnemonic.reading: KING, GUCK (きんがく): the king counts the sum of his money, covered in guck.

examples.ja: 請求書の金額を確認した。
examples.en: I checked the amount on the invoice.

items.note: Neutral. 額 alone also means forehead or a picture frame.

mnemonic.meaning: Pass (通) and go past (過). Passing through, transit.
mnemonic.reading: TSU, CAR (つうか): the car passes through the tunnel.

examples.ja: この電車は次の駅を通過します。
examples.en: This train will pass through the next station without stopping.

items.note: Also passing an exam stage or a bill: 法案が通過する.

mnemonic.meaning: 澄 has 氵 (water): the water becomes clear.
mnemonic.reading: SUE, MOO (すむ): Sue looks into the clear lake and sees a cow. Same sound as 住む (live).

examples.ja: 山の空気は澄んでいる。
examples.en: The mountain air is clear.

items.note: For water, air, sounds and eyes. 澄んだ声 = a clear voice.

mnemonic.meaning: Trust (信) and look up to (仰) the heavens. Faith, religion.
mnemonic.reading: SHIN, COKE (しんこう): his faith is shaken when he drops Coke on his shin.

examples.ja: 彼女は深い信仰を持っている。
examples.en: She has a deep religious faith.

items.note: Religious belief. 信用 / 信頼 are trust in people.

mnemonic.meaning: 溺 has 氵 (water): sinking in the water. To drown.
mnemonic.reading: OH, BORE-RUE (おぼれる): "Oh, bore me!" he drowns in boredom (and in the lake).

examples.ja: 子供が川で溺れかけた。
examples.en: A child almost drowned in the river.

items.note: Also figurative: 酒に溺れる (drown in drink). It doesn't always mean dying.

mnemonic.meaning: One (一) house (家). The whole family.
mnemonic.reading: EEK, CAR (いっか)! The whole family piles into one car.

examples.ja: 一家で海外に引っ越した。
examples.en: The whole family moved abroad.

items.note: 一家 = a household as a unit. 家族 = family members.

mnemonic.meaning: 情 has 忄 (heart): what's in your heart. Feelings, emotion.
mnemonic.reading: JOE (じょう) is full of emotion. Compassion.

examples.ja: 長く飼っていた犬に情が移った。
examples.en: I grew attached to the dog I'd kept for so long.

items.note: Mostly in set phrases: 情が深い (warm-hearted), 情に厚い.

mnemonic.meaning: Plan (企) a business (業). A company, an enterprise.
mnemonic.reading: KEY, GYO (きぎょう): the key to the company is gyoza.

examples.ja: 大企業で働いている。
examples.en: I work for a big company.

items.note: 大企業 / 中小企業 (big / small and medium companies). 会社 is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: Sudden (急) and violent (激). Abrupt, rapid.
mnemonic.reading: CUE, GECKO (きゅうげき): on cue, the gecko suddenly jumps.

examples.ja: 気温が急激に下がった。
examples.en: The temperature dropped sharply.

items.note: Stronger and more sudden than 急速 (Level 11).

mnemonic.meaning: "MOSHI, CASSEROLE TOE (もしかすると)..." Maybe there's a casserole on your toe. Perhaps.

examples.ja: もしかすると、明日は雪かもしれない。
examples.en: It might snow tomorrow.

items.note: Usually ends in かもしれない. Same as もしかしたら, a touch more formal.

mnemonic.meaning: A machine (機) at the barrier (関). An engine, an agency.
mnemonic.reading: KEY, CAN (きかん): the agency's key unlocks the can. Same sound as 期間 (period).

examples.ja: 政府の機関で働いている。
examples.en: I work for a government agency.

items.note: 交通機関 = transport system, 報道機関 = the press, 機関車 = locomotive.

mnemonic.meaning: The upper (上) class (等). First-class, superior.
mnemonic.reading: JOE, TOE (じょうとう): Joe's toe is first-class.

examples.ja: 上等な肉を使っている。
examples.en: They use top-quality meat.

items.note: Slightly old-fashioned. In slang, 上等だ! means "bring it on!"

mnemonic.meaning: Two thing kanji (物, 事): things and matters. Everything.
mnemonic.reading: MONO, GO TOE (ものごと): one thing at a time, go toe to toe with everything.

examples.ja: 物事を前向きに考えよう。
examples.en: Let's think about things positively.

items.note: Things in general: 物事の順序 (the order of things).

mnemonic.meaning: 渦 has 氵 (water): water spinning. A whirlpool.
mnemonic.reading: OOZE (うず): the whirlpool oozes everything down.

examples.ja: 川に大きな渦ができていた。
examples.en: A big whirlpool had formed in the river.

items.note: 渦巻き = spiral, swirl.

mnemonic.meaning: 留 is stay: you make it stay put. To fasten, to fix in mind.
mnemonic.reading: TOE, MAY RUE (とめる): May fastens the pin to her toe and rues it.

examples.ja: 紙をクリップで留めた。
examples.en: I fastened the papers with a clip.

items.note: 気に留める = to take notice. 止める (stop), 泊める (put up) are also とめる.

mnemonic.meaning: GACK, CARRY (がっかり): you carry the cake home and it drops. GACK! So disappointed.

examples.ja: 試合に負けて、がっかりした。
examples.en: I was disappointed to lose the match.

items.note: がっかりする is very common. 失望 (しつぼう) is a formal word.

mnemonic.meaning: 擦 has 扌 (hand): your hand rubs something.
mnemonic.reading: SUE RUE (する): Sue rubs the match and rues it. Same sound as する (do).

examples.ja: マッチを擦って火をつけた。
examples.en: I struck a match to light the fire.

items.note: Also read こする (to scrub). Usually in kana.

mnemonic.meaning: 猿 has 犭 (beast): a beast that swings from trees. A monkey.
mnemonic.reading: SARU (さる): "SAH, RUDE!" the monkey steals your hat.

examples.ja: 猿も木から落ちる。
examples.en: Even monkeys fall from trees.

items.note: The proverb above means "even experts make mistakes".

mnemonic.meaning: 深 is deep: you make it deeper. To deepen a friendship, to strengthen it.
mnemonic.reading: FOO, CAMERA (ふかめる): the camera zooms in and deepens the shot.

examples.ja: 留学で日本への理解を深めた。
examples.en: Studying abroad deepened my understanding of Japan.

items.note: Transitive. 深まる (Level 14) = it deepens.

mnemonic.meaning: 広 is wide: it becomes wide. To spread.
mnemonic.reading: HERO, MARU (ひろまる): the hero's fame spreads in a circle (まる).

examples.ja: その噂はすぐに町中に広まった。
examples.en: That rumour quickly spread through the whole town.

items.note: Intransitive (it spreads). 広める (Level 15) = you spread it.

mnemonic.meaning: The rank (位) of a single (単) item. A unit, a credit.
mnemonic.reading: TAN, EE (たんい): you need one more credit to get a tan on the beach.

examples.ja: 卒業に必要な単位を取った。
examples.en: I got the credits I need to graduate.

items.note: Unit of measurement, or a university credit.

mnemonic.meaning: 剥 has 刂 (knife): peel with a knife.
mnemonic.reading: MOO, COO (むく): the cow and the pigeon peel the apple.

examples.ja: りんごの皮を剥いた。
examples.en: I peeled an apple.

items.note: Usually in kana: むく.
